Professor Grabs Student by Collar Over 'Panvel' Remark in Ahmedabad College

A professor in an Ahmedabad college allegedly grabbed a student by the collar after the student said, "Hurry up, we have to go to Panvel." The incident occurred at a college in Ahmedabad. A video of the incident circulated, leading to an uproar. The professor reportedly threatened the student, stating he could go to any extent. The phrase "Panvel nikalna hai" is a popular meme reference from the Bollywood movie "Gola Maal."
